subject: science
passage: The shiny inner layer of many seashells, called nacre or mother-of-pearl, is made almost entirely of a mineral called aragonite. On its own, aragonite is brittle and shatters easily. ______ nacre is remarkably tough, because the mineral is arranged in thousands of tiny flat plates held together by thin layers of soft protein, like bricks in a wall of mortar, so that a crack cannot travel straight through it.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The second sentence says the mineral aragonite "is brittle and shatters easily." The last sentence says that nacre, made of that mineral, is "remarkably tough." A transition that signals a contrast between the brittle mineral and the tough shell layer is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Therefore" would mean nacre is tough because aragonite is brittle, but the text says the toughness comes from the arrangement of plates, in spite of the brittle mineral.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Similarly" signals a matching quality, but tough and brittle are opposite qualities.
explanation.C: Correct. "However" signals the contrast between the brittle mineral and the tough material it forms when arranged in plates.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nacre being tough is not an example of aragonite being brittle; it is the opposite.
